requirements.statement: app/api/deps.py imports dotmac_kernel.db only inside a function body, never at module scope, so loading it does not eagerly claim the reference assembly's runtime.
app/cli.py imports dotmac_kernel.db only inside a function body, never at module scope, so loading it does not eagerly claim the reference assembly's runtime.
app/web/context.py imports dotmac_kernel.db only inside a function body, never at module scope, so loading it does not eagerly claim the reference assembly's runtime.
app/web/labs.py imports dotmac_kernel.db only inside a function body, never at module scope, so loading it does not eagerly claim the reference assembly's runtime.

Somewhere on Academy's import path, dotmac_kernel.session_runtime.bind_database_runtime is called with a product-owned DatabaseRuntime before any dotmac_kernel module that would otherwise claim the reference assembly's engines is imported.

composition.declaration: Academy's runtime units are 9 systemd .service files and 8 systemd .timer files under deploy/, each invoking .venv/bin/python -m app.cli <subcommand> as ExecStart — there is no Dockerfile and no container entrypoint in this tree.

The only container image this tree declares is docker-compose.yml's single db service (postgres, for local development), not an application image — Academy's application process is the bare-metal systemd shape above, not a containerized one.
